authors.bio: Tom Axtell has been General Manager of Vegas PBS in Las Vegas, Nevada, since 1994. He has worked at PBS and NPR broadcast stations in Minneapolis/St. Paul, Fargo/Morehead, Spokane, and Milwaukee. He has also worked as a college vice president for advancement, legislative aide to a state senator, political campaign manager, and swimming coach. — Extensive non-broadcast and Internet media services to serve education, public health, public safety, workforce training, and the deaf and blind have been started under his leadership. — Axtell has served as a member of the PBS Board of Directors, and is on the board of Reality Works, a designer and marketer of technology-based health and education products. He currently serves on several Nevada boards and councils, including the Nevada Broadcaster's Association, Nevada Atomic Testing Museum, Green Chips, and United Way of Southern Nevada.
authors.name: Tom Axtell

authors.bio: Keith I. Graham, a seasoned broadcast professional, draws on more than 17 years operational and management experience with some of the top European broadcasters including the BBC and Thames Television. He also has more 20 years experience in systems design globally. As Solutions Development Director for AZCAR, the systems integrator of record, Graham is responsible for identifying and recommending technology solutions that best match the customer needs and aspirations. He holds a B.S. degree in communications engineering from the University of Plymouth in England and is a member of SMPTE, the Society of Broadcast Engineering (SBE), the Society of Cable and Telecommunications Engineers (SCTE) and Royal Television Society (RTS).
authors.name: Keith Graham

authors.bio: Thomas Schoeman, AIA, LEED AP is President and CEO of JMA Architecture Studios. A native of New York City and graduate of the University of New Mexico, Schoeman joined the firm in 1979. His leadership in the vision for design and the development of strategic solutions has propelled the company from a small, local company to a nationally recognized design firm, listed in the 2009 July issue of Architectural Record's “Top 100 Green Design Firms” as well as ranked 125th “Top 250 Firms” in the nation, specializing in commercial, hospitality, healthcare, and public facilities.
authors.name: Thomas Schoeman
